title: Tesla seeing the future in high-voltage experiments
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tesla seeing the future in high-voltage experiments, about late 19th-early 20th century at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: was talking about how Tesla um you know, would do some of these high voltage experiments and he would say weird things like I see the future or the present or the past

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, passes on something he says comes from a biographer of the inventor Nikola Tesla. According to that account, while Tesla was running some of his high-voltage electrical experiments, he would say strange things such as that he could see the future, the present or the past. If true, it would suggest his experiments touched something beyond ordinary physics.
